targets.arm64_apple: partial: integer functions with control flow, memory and direct register/stack-argument calls

syntax.integer functions and parameters: partial: ASCII names, decimal literals, w/l or void result, at most 64 w/l parameters
syntax.basic blocks, jumps, phi: partial: integer SSA blocks, jmp/jnz/ret/hlt, fallthrough, loops, dominance and parallel phi transfers
syntax.calls and variadic functions: partial: direct calls with up to 64 w/l register/stack arguments and a w/l or void result; recursion and external C symbols; indirect calls and variadics remain
syntax.memory and allocation: partial: integer loads/stores, loadw/loadl aliases; entry-block positive constant alloc4/8/16 and alloc1/2 aliases; effect-only constant blit copies in 0..4096 bytes for disjoint or identical spans; dynamic/non-entry allocation remains

passes.parsing and validation: partial: integer/control-flow/memory/direct-call SSA subset; full QBE syntax remains
passes.CFG, dominance and SSA construction: partial: CFG/dominance checks for SSA input; general SSA construction not implemented
passes.ABI lowering: partial: Apple AArch64 w/l register/stack arguments and integer/void results; direct calls, saved return addresses and caller live values
passes.liveness, spilling and register allocati: not implemented; baseline gives every value a stack slot
